items.en: Trump claims the US has 'total control' of the Strait of Hormuz amid distrust of Iran.

items.en: Iran’s Supreme Leader elevates military veterans willing to confront the US.
items.he: המנהיג העליון של איראן מקדם ותיקי צבא הנכונים להתעמת עם ארה"ב.

items.en: Oman condemns Colombia's recognition of Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights, following Syria.
